content: Hello, this is Mark from the Student Records Office. How can I assist you today?
Hi Mark, I'm calling to update my contact details and make sure my enrollment info is current.
Of course. To get started, could you please provide your full name and student ID number?
Sure, my name is Jamie Lee and my student ID is 582947.
Thank you, Jamie. Can you confirm your date of birth and current mailing address for verification?
My birthday is September 8, 2002, and my address is 1234 Elm Street, Apartment 5B, Springfield.
Got it. Lastly, could you provide your updated phone number and email address to make sure we have the latest contact info?
Yes, my phone number is (555) 123-4567 and my email is jamie.lee@email.com.
Thank you for confirming all that information. I've updated your records accordingly. If you need any further assistance, don't hesitate to reach out.
